notes: Reviewed against contact.png and review.html on 2026-07-06. Preserve timing, animation, hitboxes, effects, sounds, and projectiles.

moves.label: Quick Duel Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a tiny active window and long recovery after the card-hand check.
moves.reason: Standing upper-body hand check with no visible magic effect.

moves.label: Duel Disk Body Check
moves.description: Quick mid check with a short active window and weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: Arm and Duel Disk extend through the torso line.

moves.label: Card Guard Strike
moves.description: Slow mid card-hand strike with a moderate active window after the stance shift.
moves.reason: Small guarded card motion reads as a mid poke, not a summon.

moves.label: Cross Draw Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid launcher with a long recovery window after the card draw.
moves.reason: Authored launcher with a compact crossing card-hand pose.

moves.label: Duelist Side Kick
moves.description: Steady mid kick with a tiny active window and high commitment.
moves.reason: Simple standing kick, not a magic technique.

moves.label: Low Card Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with a moderate active window for clipping movement.
moves.reason: Arm and stance drop low enough to justify the low property.

moves.label: Low Duel Sweep
moves.description: Fast low sweep with very long active time that knocks down.
moves.reason: Low kick route is authored as knockdown and travels along the leg line.

moves.label: Trap Card Crush
moves.description: Quick mid crush with a short active hit that knocks down.
moves.reason: He steps in with a committed card-like strike and knockdown behavior.

moves.label: Crouch Card Jab
moves.description: Fast mid crouch jab with long active coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Starts low and pokes forward with the card hand.

moves.label: Crouch Draw Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch route is authored as a launcher and points through the midline.

moves.label: Overdrive Card Flick
moves.description: Fast high card flick with long active time and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive jab slot uses the repeated upper-body card flick.

moves.label: Millennium Aura Drive
moves.description: Slow special card drive with long active pressure that knocks down.
moves.reason: Special slot shows extended card/amulet-style poses and knockdown behavior.

moves.label: Rising Draw Check
moves.description: Fast mid while-standing check with long active time and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: While-standing route uses the same card-hand mid check.

moves.label: Rising Duel Strike
moves.description: Slow mid rising strike with steady active coverage and controlled recovery.
moves.reason: Rising route shows a forward card-hand strike at mid height.

moves.label: Downward Card Jab
moves.description: Quick high card jab with steady active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down input still animates as an upper-body card-hand jab.

moves.label: Diagonal Draw Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active hit and high whiff commitment.
moves.reason: Forward-diagonal card-hand route is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Card Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a tiny active window and long recovery.
moves.reason: Advancing command uses a plain card-hand poke.

moves.label: Forward Draw Check
moves.description: Fast mid forward check with long active time and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Forward route repeats the extended card-hand mid check.

moves.label: Quick Spell Flick
moves.description: Fast high spell-card flick with long active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle card flick is upper-body height with a casting pose.
